## 2200 - 2257

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02200">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2200 ANLC - Low water (H2O)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02200">

This exception is generated when the Water Mole % of a meter analysis record falls below the minimum value set up in the Meter Editor. This exception is generated for the violating meter analysis record and will be displayed in the Volume Editor for all meter periodic records that are associated with the meter analysis record. For example, the minimum Water Mole % is set to 0.001, but the value on the meter analysis record is 0.0000.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02201">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2201 ANLC - High water (H2O)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02201">

This exception is generated when the Water Mole % of a meter analysis record exceeds the maximum value set up in the Meter Editor. This exception is generated for the violating meter analysis record and will be displayed in the Volume Editor for all meter periodic records that are associated with the meter analysis record. For example, the maximum Water Mole % is set to 0.150, but the value on the meter analysis record is 0.1725.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02202">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2202 ANLC - Low sample pressure</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02202">

This exception is generated when the Sample Pressure on a meter analysis record falls below the minimum value set up in the Meter Editor. For example, the minimum Sample Pressure is set to 100.000, but the value on the meter analysis record is 79.2.

This exception is generated for the violating meter analysis record and will be displayed in the Volume Editor for all meter periodic records that are associated with the meter analysis record.

The Sample Pressure value on meter analysis is copied from the Sample when the Sample is applied to the meter. If the Sample Pressure needs to be edited, it can be edited on the Sample tab of the GQ/LQ Source Analysis Editor for a GQ/LQ Source sample or the Sample Analysis Editor for a standalone sample. Then the updated Sample data needs to be applied to the meter.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02206">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2206 ANLC - Low component total</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02206">

This exception is generated when the sum of all mole % values of a meter analysis record falls below the minimum value for the Component Total set up in the Meter Editor. For example, the minimum Component Total is set to 99.500 but the Total % on meter analysis is 99.372.

Total % value is a calculated, read-only value and cannot be edited. To resolve this exception, individual component mole % values will need to be adjusted appropriately rather than the Total % value.

This exception is generated for the violating meter analysis record and will be displayed in the Volume Editor for all meter periodic records that are associated with the meter analysis record.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02208">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02208">

This exception is generated when the Full Wellstream Factor value of a meter analysis record for a gas meter falls below the minimum value for the Full Well Stream set up in the Meter Editor. For example, the minimum is set to 0.950 but the value on meter analysis is 0.9030.

The Full Wellstream Factor can be seen and adjusted in the Volume Editor; if a GQ source is assigned, it can be edited on the Liq. Content tab of the GQ Source Analysis Editor.

This exception is generated for the violating meter analysis record and will be displayed in the Volume Editor for all meter periodic records that are associated with the meter analysis record.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02225">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2225 ANLC - Alkenes present in analysis</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02225">

This exception is generated when the mole % of the Alkenes (Ethylene C2H4, Propylene C3H6, Butylene C4H8) are not all null for an imported meter analysis record of a liquid meter. This exception is generated for the violating meter analysis record and will be displayed in the Volume Editor for all meter periodic records that are associated with the meter analysis record. This exception is generated only when the product on the periodic record the meter analysis record is associated with has the Show Alkenes option unchecked in the Product Editor.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02227">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2227 ANLC - Free water content exceeds contractual limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02227">

This exception is generated when the Free Water value of a meter analysis record exceeds the Operational Limit set for the Free Water (Volume H2O/Unit Vol) field in Master Data Validation. In the Meter Editor, the Compare To Mater Characteristic option needs to be set to "Yes", and Analysis Validations needs to be enabled.

For example, the Contractual Limit is set to 100.000 but the value on meter analysis is 107.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02228">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2228 ANLC - Methane content, as a percent of ethane, exceeds contractual limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02228">

This exception is generated when the ratio of the Methane C1 mole % or liquid volume % to the Ethane mole % or liquid volume % in a meter analysis record exceeds the Operational Limit for the Methane (% of Ethane) field. In the Meter Editor, the Compare To Mater Characteristic option needs to be set to "Yes", and Analysis Validations needs to be enabled.

For example, the Contractual Limit for Methane (% of Ethane) is set to 10.000 and Mole %. On a meter analysis record, the Methane C1 mole % on a meter analysis record is 1.7754 and the Ethane C2 mole % is 12.2094 on the same record. The Methane content as % of Ethane on the record then is (1.7754 / 12.2094) \* 100 = 14.5413 %, which is greater than the 10.000 Contractual Limit. Therefore this exception is generated for the meter analysis record.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02229">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2229 ANLC - CO2 content, as a percent of ethane, exceeds contractual limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02229">

This exception is generated when the ratio of the Carbon Dioxide CO2 mole % or liquid volume % to the Ethane mole % or liquid volume % in a meter analysis record exceeds the Contractual Limit for the Carbon Dioxide (% of Ethane) field. In the Meter Editor, Compare To Mater Characteristic needs to be set to "Yes", and Analysis Validations needs to be enabled.

For example, the Contractual Limit for Carbon Dioxide (% of Ethane) is set to 0.250 and Mole %. On a meter analysis record, the Carbon Dioxide CO2 mole % on a meter analysis record is 0.0311 and the Ethane C2 mole % is 12.2094 on the same record. The Carbon Dioxide content as % of Ethane on the record then is (0.0311 / 12.2094) \* 100 = 0.2547 %, which is greater than the 0.250 Contractual Limit. Therefore this exception is generated for the meter analysis record.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02230">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2230 Expert systems</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02230">

Expert systems (ES) exceptions are related to the limits defined in the Expert Systems subtab of the Meter Editor Validations tab. Expert systems statistically analyze historical data to identify uncharacteristic changes in the meter’s data flow pattern.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02231">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2231 ES - Differential pressure failed</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02231">

This exception is generated when the Differential Pressure on a periodic record falls outside of the lower and upper bounds calculated according to the Expert Systems validation configuration in the Meter Editor. For example, Average Method is set to Running; Exclude E/S Exception is set to No; Average Count is set to 5; Check is set to Yes; Method is set to Std Deviation; and the ES Limit is set to 1.000 for Differential Pressure. The mean differential pressure for five previous periodic records is 15.2 and the standard deviation is 0.1673. Then the lower bound is 15.2 – (1 \* 0.1673) = 15.3673 and 15.2 + (1 \* 0.1673) = 15.0327. If the differential pressure for the current periodic record is less than 15.3673 or greater than 15.0327, this exception will be generated for the periodic record.

The validation field Differential Pressure and therefore this exception will be available only for Orifice and Cone meter types.

</div>

The mean pulses for 10 previous periodic records is 116.92 and the standard deviation is 2.2382. Then the lower bound is 116.92 – (2 \* 2.2382) = 112.4436 and 116.92 + (2 \* 2.2382) = 121.3964. If the pulses for the current periodic record is less than 112.4436 or greater than 121.3964, this exception will be generated for the periodic record.

The validation field Pulses and therefore this exception will be available only for Coriolis, Positive Displacement, Turbine, and Ultrasonic meter types.

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02256">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2256 ES - Net standard volume higher than high benchmark</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02256">

This exception is generated when the Net Standard Volume on a periodic record exceeds the HI Limit calculated according to the Expert Systems validation configuration in the Meter Editor. For example, Average Method is set to Running; Exclude E/S Exception is set to No; Average Count is set to 10; Check is set to Yes; Method is set to Std Deviation; and the HI Limit is set to 50.000 for NSV. The mean NSV for 10 previous periodic records is 505.26. Then the Hi Limit is 505.26 + 50 = 555.26. If the NSV for the current periodic record is greater than 555.26, this exception will be generated for the periodic record.

This validation and exception apply only to liquid meters.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02257">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2257 ES - Net standard volume lower than low benchmark</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02257">

This exception is generated when the Net Standard Volume on a periodic record falls below the LO Limit calculated according to the Expert Systems validation configuration in the Meter Editor. For example, Average Method is set to Running; Exclude E/S Exception is set to No; Average Count is set to 10; Check is set to Yes; Method is set to Std Deviation; and the LO Limit is set to 30.000 for NSV. The mean NSV for 10 previous periodic records is 505.26. Then the Hi Limit is 505.26 – 30 = 475.26. If the NSV for the current periodic record is less than 475.26, this exception will be generated for the periodic record.

This validation and exception apply only to liquid meters.

</div>

</div>
